name: magaxia-backend
description: Backend modular e seguro para o sistema Magaxia, com APIs de autenticação, antifraude e ledger.

scripts.deploy:dev: npm run validate && firebase use dev && firebase deploy --only functions,hosting
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run validate && firebase use prod && firebase deploy --only functions,hosting
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd functions && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && firebase login && firebase use dev
